slots.jd.family-center.about:
Summary
Harvest Table Family Center is a family services nonprofit that helps local families reach stability through housing, food and support services. We are seeking a Case Manager to work on site in Akron, OH, supporting families from intake through case closure. A current Mandated Reporter Certificate is required for this position.
slots.jd.family-center.duties:
Duties
- Conduct home visits to assess family safety, needs and progress toward goals
- Complete intake interviews with new families and gather required documents
- Carry out needs assessments and update them as family circumstances change
- Write service plans with clear goals, responsibilities and follow-up steps
- Coordinate referrals with schools, clinics and community partners
- Keep case records current and accurate
slots.jd.family-center.needs:
Licensure and qualifications
- 4 or more years of experience in case management or social services
- Experience with referral coordination, benefits enrollment and needs assessments
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Access for tracking case data
- Skill in community outreach and in writing clear, timely case notes
- Mandated Reporter Certificate required
- Human Services Supervisor Certificate preferred
slots.r1.b1: Coordinates with schools and clinics after home visits, raising the rate of families attending follow-up appointments by 10 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Refers families to housing and food programs based on needs identified during intake interviews.
slots.r1.b3: Prepares reports for hearings that document each family's benefits enrollment status, cutting continuances caused by missing paperwork by 55 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Conducts intake and assessments for new clients and manages referral coordination with partner agencies.
slots.r1.i1: Carries a family caseload at Maple Court Care, conducting home visits to check on safety, needs and progress toward service goals.
slots.r1.i2: Serves as Case Manager at Maple Court Care, preparing reports for hearings that summarise family progress and service compliance.
slots.r2.b1: Logged home visit notes in Microsoft Access, reducing the time staff spent locating visit records by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Maintained case records and drafted court reports from file notes for caseworker review.
slots.r2.b3: Wrote service plans grounded in needs assessments, increasing the share of plans completed on schedule by 50 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Used crisis intervention skills while coordinating with schools and clinics to support tenants in urgent situations.
slots.r2.i1: Supported case managers at Stonegate Housing Authority by gathering records and drafting reports for hearings.
slots.r2.i2: Kept case records accurate and current for tenant households at Stonegate Housing Authority as a Case Aide.
slots.summary.1: Social services case manager with about 4 years of experience carrying a full caseload without close supervision. Skilled in benefits enrollment, referral coordination and court reports, with a background in home visits and needs assessments.
slots.summary.2: Casework professional with about 4 years in housing and family services, managing a full caseload independently from intake through closure. Brings practical experience in benefits enrollment, referral coordination and preparing court reports for hearings.
